courses.name: Френска защита (French Defense)
courses.plan: Укрепвайте центъра с ...e6 и ...d5, атакувайте белите пешки с ...c5 и търсете активност за белополия офицер.
courses.introduction: Играете с черните. Френската защита започва с 1. e4 e6 и 2. d4 d5. В затворен център натискът срещу d4 и пробивът ...c5 са основни идеи.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nd2 c5 4.c3 cxd4 5.cxd4 dxe4 6.Nxe4 Bb4+ 7.Bd2 Qxd4 8.Qa4+ Nc6
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. Nd2 c5 4. c3 cxd4 5. cxd4 dxe4 6. Nxe4 Bb4+ 7. Bd2 Qxd4 8. Qa4+ Nc6
lines.sourceText: Well done! We have a pawn up and white's knight is in trouble.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.e5 c5 4.c3 Qb6 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.Be2 cxd4 7.cxd4 Nge7 8.O-O Nf5 9.Be3 Qxb2 10.Nbd2 Be7
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. e5 c5 4. c3 Qb6 5. Nf3 Nc6 6. Be2 cxd4 7. cxd4 Nge7 8. O-O Nf5 9. Be3 Qxb2 10. Nbd2 Be7
lines.sourceText: French defense just won us a pawn! Woohoo!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.e5 c5 4.c3 Qb6 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.Be2 cxd4 7.cxd4 Nge7 8.O-O Nf5 9.Nc3 Nfxd4 10.Nxd4 Qxd4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. e5 c5 4. c3 Qb6 5. Nf3 Nc6 6. Be2 cxd4 7. cxd4 Nge7 8. O-O Nf5 9. Nc3 Nfxd4 10. Nxd4 Qxd4
lines.sourceText: Very nice! Can't complain about a free pawn.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.e5 c5 4.c3 Qb6 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.Bd3 cxd4 7.cxd4 Bd7 8.O-O Nxd4 9.Nxd4 Qxd4 10.Nc3 a6
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. e5 c5 4. c3 Qb6 5. Nf3 Nc6 6. Bd3 cxd4 7. cxd4 Bd7 8. O-O Nxd4 9. Nxd4 Qxd4 10. Nc3 a6
lines.sourceText: Woohoo! We are up a free pawn :)

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.e5 c5 4.Nf3 cxd4 5.Nxd4 Ne7 6.Nc3 Nbc6 7.Bb5 Bd7
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. e5 c5 4. Nf3 cxd4 5. Nxd4 Ne7 6. Nc3 Nbc6 7. Bb5 Bd7
lines.sourceText: Well done! We are almost done developing and have 2 central pawns to white's 1.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.e5 c5 4.Nf3 cxd4 5.Nxd4 Ne7 6.Nc3 Nbc6 7.Nxc6 Nxc6
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. e5 c5 4. Nf3 cxd4 5. Nxd4 Ne7 6. Nc3 Nbc6 7. Nxc6 Nxc6
lines.sourceText: Well done! We have 2 central pawns to white's 1, leaving us with a bit of an advantage.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bg5 Bb4 5.e5 h6 6.exf6 hxg5 7.fxg7 Rg8 8.Qh5 Qf6
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. Bg5 Bb4 5. e5 h6 6. exf6 hxg5 7. fxg7 Rg8 8. Qh5 Qf6
lines.sourceText: Well done! We have a 60% winrate from here.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.e5 c5 4.Nf3 cxd4 5.Qxd4 Nc6 6.Bb5 Ne7
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. e5 c5 4. Nf3 cxd4 5. Qxd4 Nc6 6. Bb5 Ne7
lines.sourceText: Well done! With white's queen slightly mispositioned, we have a small advantage coming into the middlegame

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.e5 c5 4.dxc5 Bxc5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. e5 c5 4. dxc5 Bxc5
lines.sourceText: Well done! White is going to have a hard time holding onto that weak e5 pawn.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.e5 Nfd7 5.Nf3 c5 6.Bg5 Qb6
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. e5 Nfd7 5. Nf3 c5 6. Bg5 Qb6
lines.sourceText: Well done! We're going to get rid of the d4 pawn, which destabilizes the e5 pawn and white's whole center.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.exd5 exd5 4.Nc3 Nf6 5.Nf3 Bb4 6.Bd2 O-O
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. exd5 exd5 4. Nc3 Nf6 5. Nf3 Bb4 6. Bd2 O-O
lines.sourceText: The exchange french is super boring. White did not want us to have any fun this game.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.exd5 exd5 4.Bd3 Nc6 5.Nf3 Nb4 6.O-O Nxd3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. exd5 exd5 4. Bd3 Nc6 5. Nf3 Nb4 6. O-O Nxd3
lines.sourceText: Well done! We have a slight eval advantage and we win over half our games from here! Next, we'll continue developing and castle kingside

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Bd3 dxe4 4.Bxe4 Nf6 5.Bf3 c5 6.Ne2 Be7
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. Bd3 dxe4 4. Bxe4 Nf6 5. Bf3 c5 6. Ne2 Be7
lines.sourceText: Perfectly played! We'll castle and finish up our development next.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nd2 c5 4.c3 cxd4 5.cxd4 dxe4 6.Nxe4 Bb4+ 7.Nc3 Nf6 8.Nf3 O-O 9.Bd3 b6 10.O-O Bb7
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. Nd2 c5 4. c3 cxd4 5. cxd4 dxe4 6. Nxe4 Bb4+ 7. Nc3 Nf6 8. Nf3 O-O 9. Bd3 b6 10. O-O Bb7
lines.sourceText: We are looking fantastic here. Well done.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bg5 Bb4 5.e5 h6 6.Bd2 Bxc3 7.bxc3 Ne4 8.Bd3 Nxd2 9.Qxd2 c5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. Bg5 Bb4 5. e5 h6 6. Bd2 Bxc3 7. bxc3 Ne4 8. Bd3 Nxd2 9. Qxd2 c5
lines.sourceText: Well done! Both sides played at literally 100% accuracy.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.exd5 exd5 4.c4 Bb4+ 5.Nc3 Nf6 6.Nf3 O-O 7.Be2 dxc4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. exd5 exd5 4. c4 Bb4+ 5. Nc3 Nf6 6. Nf3 O-O 7. Be2 dxc4
lines.sourceText: Nice! Because we wasted one of whites moves, we are slightly ahead in the eval bar.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.exd5 exd5 4.Bd3 Nc6 5.c3 Bd6
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. exd5 exd5 4. Bd3 Nc6 5. c3 Bd6
lines.sourceText: Nice! In the future we'll go g-knight to e7 and short-castle.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nd2 c5 4.exd5 Qxd5 5.dxc5 Bxc5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. Nd2 c5 4. exd5 Qxd5 5. dxc5 Bxc5
lines.sourceText: Nice, we have a bit more development and will be first to castle.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.exd5 exd5 4.Nf3 Nf6 5.Bd3 Bd6 6.O-O O-O 7.c3 Bg4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. exd5 exd5 4. Nf3 Nf6 5. Bd3 Bd6 6. O-O O-O 7. c3 Bg4
lines.sourceText: Nice! It's a symmetrical and dead even position

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nd2 c5 4.exd5 Qxd5 5.Ngf3 cxd4 6.Bc4 Qd6 7.O-O Nf6 8.Nb3 Nc6 9.Nbxd4 Nxd4 10.Nxd4 Be7
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. Nd2 c5 4. exd5 Qxd5 5. Ngf3 cxd4 6. Bc4 Qd6 7. O-O Nf6 8. Nb3 Nc6 9. Nbxd4 Nxd4 10. Nxd4 Be7
lines.sourceText: Nice - both sides played absolutely perfectly.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nd2 c5 4.Ngf3 cxd4 5.Nxd4 Nc6 6.Bb5 Ne7
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. Nd2 c5 4. Ngf3 cxd4 5. Nxd4 Nc6 6. Bb5 Ne7
lines.sourceText: Nice, the game is dead even so far. Good luck with the rest of it.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bg5 Bb4 5.e5 h6 6.Bh4 g5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. Bg5 Bb4 5. e5 h6 6. Bh4 g5
lines.sourceText: Well done! Once black removes their bishop, we can finally bring our knight to safety.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.exd5 exd5 4.Nf3 Nf6 5.Bd3 Bd6 6.O-O O-O 7.Bg5 Bg4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. exd5 exd5 4. Nf3 Nf6 5. Bd3 Bd6 6. O-O O-O 7. Bg5 Bg4
lines.sourceText: It's a completely even and symmetrical position - good luck with the rest of your game :)

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.e5 c5 4.c3 Qb6 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.a3 c4 7.Nbd2 Na5 8.Be2 Bd7
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. e5 c5 4. c3 Qb6 5. Nf3 Nc6 6. a3 c4 7. Nbd2 Na5 8. Be2 Bd7
lines.sourceText: Nice!! Look how white's e2 bishop, d2 knight, and c1 bishop all can't move. It's wild how paralyzed they are.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bg5 Bb4 5.e5 h6 6.Bd2 Bxc3 7.bxc3 Ne4 8.Qg4 g6 9.Bd3 Nxd2 10.Kxd2 c5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. Bg5 Bb4 5. e5 h6 6. Bd2 Bxc3 7. bxc3 Ne4 8. Qg4 g6 9. Bd3 Nxd2 10. Kxd2 c5
lines.sourceText: This was a perfectly played opening from both sides - now onto the rest of the game!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.e5 Nfd7 5.f4 c5 6.Nf3 Nc6 7.Be3 cxd4 8.Nxd4 Bc5 9.Qd2 O-O
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. e5 Nfd7 5. f4 c5 6. Nf3 Nc6 7. Be3 cxd4 8. Nxd4 Bc5 9. Qd2 O-O
lines.sourceText: Both sides. 100% accuracy. Wow.

courses.name: Испанска партия (Ruy Lopez)
courses.plan: Развивайте фигурите, обезопасете царя и подгответе централния пробив d4. Пазете офицера, когато той поддържа натиска срещу черния център.
courses.introduction: Играете с белите. Испанската партия започва с 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5. Офицерът атакува защитника на e5, а развитието и натискът в центъра са по-важни от прибързаното вземане на пешки.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 d6 4.d4 a6 5.Bxc6+ bxc6 6.dxe5 dxe5 7.Qxd8+ Kxd8 8.Nxe5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 d6 4. d4 a6 5. Bxc6+ bxc6 6. dxe5 dxe5 7. Qxd8+ Kxd8 8. Nxe5
lines.sourceText: Well done! We are up a pawn and also threatening a nasty fork on f7. The computer loves our position and graces it with a +2.5 point advantage.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Bc5 4.c3 d6 5.d4 exd4 6.cxd4 Bb4+ 7.Kf1 Bd7 8.Qa4 a5 9.a3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Bc5 4. c3 d6 5. d4 exd4 6. cxd4 Bb4+ 7. Kf1 Bd7 8. Qa4 a5 9. a3
lines.sourceText: Nice!! I won't complain about a free bishop.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 d6 4.d4 a6 5.Bxc6+ bxc6 6.dxe5 Bg4 7.O-O dxe5 8.Qxd8+ Rxd8 9.Nxe5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 d6 4. d4 a6 5. Bxc6+ bxc6 6. dxe5 Bg4 7. O-O dxe5 8. Qxd8+ Rxd8 9. Nxe5
lines.sourceText: Sweet! A free pawn!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 d6 4.d4 exd4 5.Nxd4 Bd7 6.Nc3 Nxd4 7.Bxd7+ Qxd7 8.Qxd4 Nf6 9.Bf4 Be7 10.O-O-O O-O 11.e5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 d6 4. d4 exd4 5. Nxd4 Bd7 6. Nc3 Nxd4 7. Bxd7+ Qxd7 8. Qxd4 Nf6 9. Bf4 Be7 10. O-O-O O-O 11. e5
lines.sourceText: Well done!! There's a few ways black can try to untangle themselves out of this, but honestly none of them will work. We have a crushing position.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Bc5 4.c3 d6 5.d4 exd4 6.cxd4 Bb4+ 7.Kf1 a6 8.Bxc6+ bxc6 9.Qa4 a5 10.a3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Bc5 4. c3 d6 5. d4 exd4 6. cxd4 Bb4+ 7. Kf1 a6 8. Bxc6+ bxc6 9. Qa4 a5 10. a3
lines.sourceText: Nice! That bishop is ours.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Bc5 4.c3 Nf6 5.d4 exd4 6.e5 Ng4 7.cxd4 Bb4+ 8.Nc3 O-O 9.O-O
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Bc5 4. c3 Nf6 5. d4 exd4 6. e5 Ng4 7. cxd4 Bb4+ 8. Nc3 O-O 9. O-O
lines.sourceText: Well done! Our dominant center gives us a +2.5 point advantage over our poor opponent.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 a6 4.Ba4 Nf6 5.d4 exd4 6.O-O Bc5 7.e5 Nd5 8.Bb3 Nb6 9.Ng5 O-O 10.Qh5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 4. Ba4 Nf6 5. d4 exd4 6. O-O Bc5 7. e5 Nd5 8. Bb3 Nb6 9. Ng5 O-O 10. Qh5
lines.sourceText: Nice!! Black is likely going to be checkmated here, or if not, they're going to be in a world of trouble.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Bc5 4.c3 d6 5.d4 exd4 6.cxd4 Bb6 7.d5 a6 8.Ba4 Bd7 9.dxc6
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Bc5 4. c3 d6 5. d4 exd4 6. cxd4 Bb6 7. d5 a6 8. Ba4 Bd7 9. dxc6
lines.sourceText: Nice! We're up a whole knight.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 a6 4.Ba4 Nf6 5.d4 exd4 6.O-O Bc5 7.e5 Nd5 8.Bb3 Nde7 9.Ng5 O-O 10.Qh5 h6 11.Nxf7 Rxf7 12.Bxf7+
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 4. Ba4 Nf6 5. d4 exd4 6. O-O Bc5 7. e5 Nd5 8. Bb3 Nde7 9. Ng5 O-O 10. Qh5 h6 11. Nxf7 Rxf7 12. Bxf7+
lines.sourceText: Well done! Our attack is going to destroy black.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Nf6 4.O-O a6 5.Bxc6 dxc6 6.Nxe5 Bd6 7.Nf3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Nf6 4. O-O a6 5. Bxc6 dxc6 6. Nxe5 Bd6 7. Nf3
lines.sourceText: Well done! We literally just have a pawn. I can't complain.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Nf6 4.O-O a6 5.Bxc6 dxc6 6.Nxe5 Qd4 7.Nf3 Qxe4 8.Re1 Qxe1+ 9.Qxe1+
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Nf6 4. O-O a6 5. Bxc6 dxc6 6. Nxe5 Qd4 7. Nf3 Qxe4 8. Re1 Qxe1+ 9. Qxe1+
lines.sourceText: LMAO, you're a queen up! This win isn't so much because we played perfectly, but more because Black tried to be sneaky and completely misunderstood the position. Well, a win is a win!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Nf6 4.O-O Nxe4 5.d4 exd4 6.Re1 d5 7.Nxd4 Bd7 8.Bxc6 bxc6 9.f3 Bc5 10.fxe4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Nf6 4. O-O Nxe4 5. d4 exd4 6. Re1 d5 7. Nxd4 Bd7 8. Bxc6 bxc6 9. f3 Bc5 10. fxe4
lines.sourceText: We are simply a knight up. Nice job!!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Bc5 4.c3 d6 5.d4 exd4 6.cxd4 Bb4+ 7.Kf1 Bd7 8.Qa4 Nge7 9.d5 a6 10.dxc6 axb5 11.cxd7+ Qxd7 12.Qxa8+
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Bc5 4. c3 d6 5. d4 exd4 6. cxd4 Bb4+ 7. Kf1 Bd7 8. Qa4 Nge7 9. d5 a6 10. dxc6 axb5 11. cxd7+ Qxd7 12. Qxa8+
lines.sourceText: Up 7 points of material. Not bad.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Nf6 4.O-O Bc5 5.Nxe5 Nxe5 6.d4 Bd6 7.dxe5 Bxe5 8.f4 Bd6 9.e5 Bc5+ 10.Kh1 Ne4 11.Qe2 Nf2+ 12.Rxf2 Bxf2 13.Qxf2
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Nf6 4. O-O Bc5 5. Nxe5 Nxe5 6. d4 Bd6 7. dxe5 Bxe5 8. f4 Bd6 9. e5 Bc5+ 10. Kh1 Ne4 11. Qe2 Nf2+ 12. Rxf2 Bxf2 13. Qxf2
lines.sourceText: I mean seriously, the rest of blacks pieces haven't even MOVED yet. We are dominating here.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Nf6 4.O-O Bc5 5.Nxe5 Nxe5 6.d4 Bxd4 7.Qxd4 Nc6 8.Bxc6 bxc6 9.Bg5 O-O 10.e5 h6 11.Bh4 g5 12.exf6 gxh4 13.Qg4+ Kh7 14.Qg7#
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Nf6 4. O-O Bc5 5. Nxe5 Nxe5 6. d4 Bxd4 7. Qxd4 Nc6 8. Bxc6 bxc6 9. Bg5 O-O 10. e5 h6 11. Bh4 g5 12. exf6 gxh4 13. Qg4+ Kh7 14. Qg7#
lines.sourceText: If you do this in a game, screenshot it and send it to me at ethan@chessreps.com

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Nf6 4.O-O Bc5 5.Nxe5 Nxe5 6.d4 Bd6 7.dxe5 Bxe5 8.f4 Bd6 9.e5 Bc5+ 10.Kh1 Ne4 11.Qe2 c6 12.Bd3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Nf6 4. O-O Bc5 5. Nxe5 Nxe5 6. d4 Bd6 7. dxe5 Bxe5 8. f4 Bd6 9. e5 Bc5+ 10. Kh1 Ne4 11. Qe2 c6 12. Bd3
lines.sourceText: Well done! Black's knight is essentially trapped in the middle of the board. The computer puts us at a +4 point advantage and we win from here 80% of the time, even though the material is completely equal!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 d6 4.d4 Bd7 5.Nc3 Nf6 6.Bxc6 Bxc6 7.Qd3 Be7 8.dxe5 dxe5 9.Nxe5 Qxd3 10.cxd3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 d6 4. d4 Bd7 5. Nc3 Nf6 6. Bxc6 Bxc6 7. Qd3 Be7 8. dxe5 dxe5 9. Nxe5 Qxd3 10. cxd3
lines.sourceText: Nice!! We are up a pawn & own the center. We have like an 80% winrate from here.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 a6 4.Ba4 b5 5.Bb3 Nf6 6.d4 Nxd4 7.Nxd4 exd4 8.e5 Ne4 9.Qf3 d5 10.exd6 Nxd6 11.Qxa8
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 4. Ba4 b5 5. Bb3 Nf6 6. d4 Nxd4 7. Nxd4 exd4 8. e5 Ne4 9. Qf3 d5 10. exd6 Nxd6 11. Qxa8
lines.sourceText: That's how it's done!!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 a6 4.Ba4 b5 5.Bb3 Nf6 6.d4 Nxd4 7.Nxd4 exd4 8.e5 Ng8 9.Qf3 Qe7 10.Qxa8
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 4. Ba4 b5 5. Bb3 Nf6 6. d4 Nxd4 7. Nxd4 exd4 8. e5 Ng8 9. Qf3 Qe7 10. Qxa8
lines.sourceText: Aaaaaand now we have a rook. Game over. Black should resign. Chess is easy huh?

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 a6 4.Ba4 Nf6 5.d4 exd4 6.O-O Be7 7.e5 Ne4 8.Nxd4 Nc5 9.Nf5 Nxa4 10.Nxg7+ Kf8 11.Bh6 Kg8 12.f4 d6 13.e6
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 4. Ba4 Nf6 5. d4 exd4 6. O-O Be7 7. e5 Ne4 8. Nxd4 Nc5 9. Nf5 Nxa4 10. Nxg7+ Kf8 11. Bh6 Kg8 12. f4 d6 13. e6
lines.sourceText: Well done! From here, do whatever you can to put your queen on g4 and win the game.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 a6 4.Ba4 Nf6 5.d4 exd4 6.O-O b5 7.Bb3 Bc5 8.e5 Ng4 9.Bd5 O-O 10.h3 Nh6 11.Bxh6 gxh6 12.Nbd2

courses.name: Отказан дамски гамбит (Queen's Gambit Declined)
courses.plan: Поддържайте центъра с d4 и c4, развийте фигурите и изберете подходящ момент за размяна на d5 или пробив e4.
courses.introduction: Играете с белите срещу отказан дамски гамбит. След 1. d4 d5 2. c4 e6 черните укрепват центъра. Учете развитието, натиска срещу d5 и тактиката по диагоналите.

courses.name: Приет дамски гамбит (Queen's Gambit Accepted)
courses.plan: Използвайте централното пространство, развивайте фигурите с темпо и възстановете пешката на c4, когато това подпомага развитието.
courses.introduction: Играете с белите. След 1. d4 d5 2. c4 dxc4 черните временно вземат пешка. Вашата цел е активен център и бързо развитие; не губете темпа само за да си върнете пешката веднага.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 dxc4 3.e4 b5 4.a4 c6 5.axb5 cxb5 6.Nc3 Bd7 7.d5 e6 8.dxe6 fxe6 9.Nxb5 Bxb5 10.Qh5+ g6 11.Qxb5+

lines.sourceText: This is just complete brutality. No hope at all for them in this position.

lines.sourceText: Well done! We have a great position and the computer puts us at a 1 or 2 point advantage.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 dxc4 3.e4 e5 4.Nf3 exd4 5.Bxc4 c5 6.Ne5 Be6 7.Bxe6 fxe6 8.Qh5+ g6 9.Nxg6 Nf6 10.Qh3

lines.sourceText: Well done! We are putting pressure on Black's pinned rook and attacking the e6 pawn. Things are looking great for us.

courses.name: Староиндийска защита (King's Indian Defense)
courses.plan: Завършете фианкетото, рокирайте и атакувайте белия център с подходящия пробив ...e5 или ...c5. Съобразявайте фланговата атака с централната структура.
courses.introduction: Играете с черните. Староиндийската защита изгражда фианкето с ...Nf6, ...g6 и ...Bg7. Давате пространство в центъра, след което го атакувате с пешечни пробиви и активни фигури.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 Bg7 4.e4 d6 5.Nf3 O-O 6.Bd3 Bg4 7.h3 Bxf3 8.Qxf3 Nc6 9.Be3 Nd7 10.Ne2 Nde5 11.dxe5 Nxe5 12.Qg3 Nxd3+ 13.Kd2 Nxb2

lines.sourceText: Well done! The game is essentially over.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 Bg7 4.e4 d6 5.Nf3 O-O 6.Be2 e5 7.O-O exd4 8.Nxd4 Re8 9.f3 c6 10.Be3 d5 11.cxd5 Nxd5 12.Bf2 Nf4 13.Bc4 Qg5 14.Bg3 Qc5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 g6 3. Nc3 Bg7 4. e4 d6 5. Nf3 O-O 6. Be2 e5 7. O-O exd4 8. Nxd4 Re8 9. f3 c6 10. Be3 d5 11. cxd5 Nxd5 12. Bf2 Nf4 13. Bc4 Qg5 14. Bg3 Qc5
lines.sourceText: Well done! We left our knight to die, but we are completely winning here because we'll actually get TWO pieces back. In our next moves, we'll take the knight on d4 with our bishop with check, then proceed to take the c4 bishop. Because we end a piece up, the computer gives us a +3 point advantage.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 Bg7 4.e4 d6 5.f4 O-O 6.Nf3 c5 7.d5 e6 8.Bd3 exd5 9.cxd5 b5 10.Nxb5 Re8 11.Nc3 Nxe4 12.Nxe4 f5

lines.sourceText: Not only will we win our material back, this position is very hard to hold on to as White. In fact, we're winning from here like 75% of the time, and the computer gives us a big advantage.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 Bg7 4.e4 d6 5.Nf3 O-O 6.Be2 e5 7.dxe5 dxe5 8.Qxd8 Rxd8 9.Nxe5 Nxe4 10.Nxf7 Bxc3+ 11.bxc3 Kxf7

lines.sourceText: Well done!! We are simply up a piece and will win this game.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 Bg7 4.e4 d6 5.f4 O-O 6.e5 dxe5 7.fxe5 Nfd7 8.Nf3 c5 9.Be3 cxd4 10.Bxd4 Nc6 11.Be2 Nxd4 12.Qxd4 Nxe5 13.Qxd8 Rxd8 14.Nxe5 Bxe5

lines.sourceText: Well done! We're in an endgame up a pawn, with a safer king, and more developed pieces. The computer gives us a +4 point advantage and we win here over 70% of the time.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 Bg7 4.e4 d6 5.Nf3 O-O 6.Be2 e5 7.O-O exd4 8.Nxd4 Re8 9.f3 c6 10.Be3 d5 11.cxd5 Nxd5 12.Bf2 Nf4 13.Bc4 Qg5 14.g3 Nh3+

lines.sourceText: Well done! In a second we'll grab the bishop and move our rook to d8 to pin the knight to the queen. The computer gives us a +2 point advantage.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 Bg7 4.e4 d6 5.f4 O-O 6.Nf3 c5 7.d5 e6 8.Bd3 exd5 9.cxd5 b5 10.O-O c4 11.Bc2 b4 12.Ne2 Re8
lines.sourcePgn: 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 g6 3. Nc3 Bg7 4. e4 d6 5. f4 O-O 6. Nf3 c5 7. d5 e6 8. Bd3 exd5 9. cxd5 b5 10. O-O c4 11. Bc2 b4 12. Ne2 Re8
lines.sourceText: Well done! The computer gives us a +1 point advantage and we win over 60% of our games from here.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 Bg7 4.e4 d6 5.f3 O-O 6.Be3 c5 7.d5 e6 8.Qd2 exd5 9.cxd5 a6 10.Bh6 Nxe4 11.Nxe4 Qh4+ 12.g3 Qxh6 13.Qxh6 Bxh6 14.Nxd6 Nd7
lines.sourcePgn: 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 g6 3. Nc3 Bg7 4. e4 d6 5. f3 O-O 6. Be3 c5 7. d5 e6 8. Qd2 exd5 9. cxd5 a6 10. Bh6 Nxe4 11. Nxe4 Qh4+ 12. g3 Qxh6 13. Qxh6 Bxh6 14. Nxd6 Nd7

courses.name: Скандинавска защита (Scandinavian Defense)
courses.plan: След ранното излизане на дамата развийте леките фигури и обезопасете царя. Следете централните линии и избягвайте ненужни ходове с дамата.
courses.introduction: Играете с черните. Скандинавската защита започва с 1. e4 d5 и веднага оспорва центъра. Упражнявайте безопасните полета за дамата, бързото развитие и типичните тактически отговори.

courses.name: Защита Петров (Petrov Defense)
courses.plan: Следете взаимните заплахи срещу централните пешки, развивайте фигурите и използвайте отворените линии след размяната в центъра.
courses.introduction: Играете с черните. Защита Петров започва с 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nf6. Вместо пасивно да пазите e5, атакувате e4. Правилният ред на вземанията е важен за материалния баланс.

courses.name: Английско начало (English Opening)
courses.plan: Контролирайте d5 с c4, развивайте фигурите според черната подредба и изберете подходящ централен пробив.
courses.introduction: Играете с белите. Английското начало започва с 1. c4 и упражнява натиск върху d5 от фланга. Гъвкавата подредба позволява различни пешечни структури и преходи към други дебюти.

lines.pgn: 1.c4 Nf6 2.Nc3 e6 3.e4 Bb4 4.e5 Bxc3 5.bxc3 Ne4 6.Qg4 Ng5 7.h4

lines.sourceText: Beautiful! Black has a few ways to save the g7 pawn, but they all come at a cost of pawn structure or development. The computer loves our position so much that we get a +1.3 point advantage.

Nice! Our center is stronger and we have more development than black. The computer gives us a +1 point advantage.

lines.pgn: 1.c4 g6 2.Nc3 Bg7 3.g3 d6 4.Bg2 Nf6 5.Nf3 O-O 6.O-O
lines.sourcePgn: 1. c4 g6 2. Nc3 Bg7 3. g3 d6 4. Bg2 Nf6 5. Nf3 O-O 6. O-O
lines.sourceText: Well done! That's what I like to see :) It's a symmetrical game, and you'll play on from here.

lines.pgn: 1.c4 c5 2.Nc3 Nc6 3.g3 g6 4.Bg2 Bg7 5.Nf3 Nf6 6.d4 cxd4 7.Nxd4 O-O 8.O-O
lines.sourcePgn: 1. c4 c5 2. Nc3 Nc6 3. g3 g6 4. Bg2 Bg7 5. Nf3 Nf6 6. d4 cxd4 7. Nxd4 O-O 8. O-O
lines.sourceText: That was... emotional

lines.pgn: 1.c4 c6 2.Nf3 d5 3.e3 Nf6 4.Nc3 Bg4 5.Qb3 Qb6 6.Ne5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. c4 c6 2. Nf3 d5 3. e3 Nf6 4. Nc3 Bg4 5. Qb3 Qb6 6. Ne5
lines.sourceText: Nice!! We got out of that sticky pin. And if black ever trades our queens, we're happy to open up the a-file for our rook.

lines.pgn: 1.c4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.Nf3 Nc6 4.e3 Bb4 5.Qc2 d6 6.Nd5 Bc5 7.a3 a5 8.b3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. c4 e5 2. Nc3 Nf6 3. Nf3 Nc6 4. e3 Bb4 5. Qc2 d6 6. Nd5 Bc5 7. a3 a5 8. b3
lines.sourceText: Well done! We'll plant our bishop on b2 next, and then play the game from there.

lines.pgn: 1.c4 e5 2.Nc3 d6 3.Nf3 f5 4.g3 Nf6 5.Bg2
lines.sourcePgn: 1. c4 e5 2. Nc3 d6 3. Nf3 f5 4. g3 Nf6 5. Bg2
lines.sourceText: Well done! After a castle, we'll enjoy the rest of the game with an extremely strong bishop on g2.

lines.pgn: 1.c4 Nf6 2.Nc3 e6 3.e4 d5 4.e5 d4 5.exf6 dxc3 6.bxc3 Qxf6 7.Nf3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. c4 Nf6 2. Nc3 e6 3. e4 d5 4. e5 d4 5. exf6 dxc3 6. bxc3 Qxf6 7. Nf3
lines.sourceText: Nice! Next, we'll develop our bishop to d3 and then castle. The position is about equal.

lines.pgn: 1.c4 e6 2.Nc3 d5 3.e3 Nf6 4.Nf3 Be7 5.b3 O-O 6.Bb2 c5 7.cxd5 exd5 8.d4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. c4 e6 2. Nc3 d5 3. e3 Nf6 4. Nf3 Be7 5. b3 O-O 6. Bb2 c5 7. cxd5 exd5 8. d4
lines.sourceText: Nice! We put an end to blacks central pawn storm.

courses.name: Сицилианска защита: вариант Алапин (Alapin Sicilian)
courses.plan: Подготвяйте d4 с c3, поддържайте центъра и развивайте фигурите бързо. Следете тактическите заплахи срещу e4 и d4.
courses.introduction: Играете с белите. Срещу 1. e4 c5 избирате 2. c3, за да подготвите d4. Конят b1 временно губи полето c3, затова точният ред на ходовете и развитието са важни.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 c5 2.c3 Nc6 3.d4 cxd4 4.cxd4 d6 5.d5 Ne5 6.f4 Nd7 7.Nf3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 c5 2. c3 Nc6 3. d4 cxd4 4. cxd4 d6 5. d5 Ne5 6. f4 Nd7 7. Nf3
lines.sourceText: Well done! Black is completely paralyzed here

lines.pgn: 1.e4 c5 2.c3 Nc6 3.d4 cxd4 4.cxd4 d5 5.exd5 Qxd5 6.Nf3 Bg4 7.Nc3 Qd8 8.d5 Ne5 9.Nxe5 Bxd1 10.Bb5+ Qd7 11.Bxd7+ Kd8 12.Kxd1
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 c5 2. c3 Nc6 3. d4 cxd4 4. cxd4 d5 5. exd5 Qxd5 6. Nf3 Bg4 7. Nc3 Qd8 8. d5 Ne5 9. Nxe5 Bxd1 10. Bb5+ Qd7 11. Bxd7+ Kd8 12. Kxd1
lines.sourceText: What a gorgeous line. Your opponent will probably report you for cheating.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 c5 2.c3 Nc6 3.d4 cxd4 4.cxd4 d6 5.d5 Ne5 6.f4 Ng6 7.Nf3 Nf6 8.e5 dxe5 9.fxe5 Nxd5 10.Bb5+ Bd7 11.Qxd5 Qa5+ 12.Nc3

lines.sourceText: Better development, better center, and did I mention we're a piece up?

lines.pgn: 1.e4 c5 2.c3 d6 3.d4 cxd4 4.cxd4 Nf6 5.Nc3 Nc6 6.d5 Ne5 7.f4 Ng6 8.Nf3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 c5 2. c3 d6 3. d4 cxd4 4. cxd4 Nf6 5. Nc3 Nc6 6. d5 Ne5 7. f4 Ng6 8. Nf3
lines.sourceText: The computer gives us a +2 eval advantage just because our center is soooo good.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 c5 2.c3 Nc6 3.d4 cxd4 4.cxd4 d6 5.d5 Ne5 6.f4 Ng6 7.Nf3 e6 8.dxe6 Bxe6 9.f5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 c5 2. c3 Nc6 3. d4 cxd4 4. cxd4 d6 5. d5 Ne5 6. f4 Ng6 7. Nf3 e6 8. dxe6 Bxe6 9. f5
lines.sourceText: The piece is ours and the game is OVER!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 c5 2.c3 d5 3.exd5 Qxd5 4.d4 cxd4 5.cxd4 Nc6 6.Nf3 Bg4 7.Nc3 Qa5 8.d5 Ne5 9.Bb5+ Nd7 10.O-O
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 c5 2. c3 d5 3. exd5 Qxd5 4. d4 cxd4 5. cxd4 Nc6 6. Nf3 Bg4 7. Nc3 Qa5 8. d5 Ne5 9. Bb5+ Nd7 10. O-O
lines.sourceText: Well done! Although the material is equal, black is in huge trouble here. Their pieces are uncoordinated, undeveloped, and unsafe. The computer loves our position so much that it gives us a +3 point advantage and 70% winrate from here!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 c5 2.c3 d5 3.exd5 Qxd5 4.d4 Nf6 5.Nf3 Bg4 6.Qa4+ Nc6 7.Bc4 Qe4+ 8.Be3 Bxf3 9.Nd2 Qg4 10.Nxf3 Qxg2 11.Ke2 e6 12.Ba6 O-O-O 13.Qxc6+ Kb8 14.Qxb7#
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 c5 2. c3 d5 3. exd5 Qxd5 4. d4 Nf6 5. Nf3 Bg4 6. Qa4+ Nc6 7. Bc4 Qe4+ 8. Be3 Bxf3 9. Nd2 Qg4 10. Nxf3 Qxg2 11. Ke2 e6 12. Ba6 O-O-O 13. Qxc6+ Kb8 14. Qxb7#
lines.sourceText: Crazy how quick we went from defending black's attack to checkmating black ourselves.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 c5 2.c3 d5 3.exd5 Qxd5 4.d4 Nf6 5.Nf3 Bg4 6.Qa4+ Nc6 7.Bc4 Qe4+ 8.Be3 Bxf3 9.Nd2 Qg4 10.Nxf3 Qxg2 11.Ke2 e6 12.Ba6 Rb8 13.Bxb7 Rxb7 14.Qxc6+ Rd7 15.Rhg1 Qh3 16.Ne5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 c5 2. c3 d5 3. exd5 Qxd5 4. d4 Nf6 5. Nf3 Bg4 6. Qa4+ Nc6 7. Bc4 Qe4+ 8. Be3 Bxf3 9. Nd2 Qg4 10. Nxf3 Qxg2 11. Ke2 e6 12. Ba6 Rb8 13. Bxb7 Rxb7 14. Qxc6+ Rd7 15. Rhg1 Qh3 16. Ne5
lines.sourceText: We are completely and utterly crushing black here. In a second we are about to win their rook and then probably the game.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 c5 2.c3 Nc6 3.d4 cxd4 4.cxd4 d6 5.d5 Ne5 6.f4 Ng6 7.Nf3 Nf6 8.e5 dxe5 9.fxe5 Nd7 10.e6 fxe6 11.dxe6 Nf6 12.Qa4+ Nd7 13.exd7+

lines.sourceText: I love a free knight

lines.pgn: 1.e4 c5 2.c3 e6 3.d4 d5 4.exd5 exd5 5.Bb5+ Nc6 6.Nf3 Bd7 7.O-O Nf6 8.Bg5 Be7 9.dxc5 Bxc5 10.Re1+ Be7 11.Bxf6 gxf6 12.Qxd5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 c5 2. c3 e6 3. d4 d5 4. exd5 exd5 5. Bb5+ Nc6 6. Nf3 Bd7 7. O-O Nf6 8. Bg5 Be7 9. dxc5 Bxc5 10. Re1+ Be7 11. Bxf6 gxf6 12. Qxd5
lines.sourceText: Black is humiliated here.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 c5 2.c3 g6 3.d4 cxd4 4.cxd4 Bg7 5.Nc3 d6 6.Nf3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 c5 2. c3 g6 3. d4 cxd4 4. cxd4 Bg7 5. Nc3 d6 6. Nf3
lines.sourceText: We got everything we wanted out of this opening - the center and development. You can play bishop to b5 next

lines.pgn: 1.e4 c5 2.c3 d6 3.d4 cxd4 4.cxd4 Nf6 5.Nc3 e6 6.Nf3 Be7 7.Bd3 O-O 8.O-O
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 c5 2. c3 d6 3. d4 cxd4 4. cxd4 Nf6 5. Nc3 e6 6. Nf3 Be7 7. Bd3 O-O 8. O-O
lines.sourceText: We're looking great! Pawns in the center, pieces developed, and king castled. The eval bar gives us +1 point advantage.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 c5 2.c3 e6 3.d4 cxd4 4.cxd4 d5 5.e5 Nc6 6.Nf3 Bb4+ 7.Nc3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 c5 2. c3 e6 3. d4 cxd4 4. cxd4 d5 5. e5 Nc6 6. Nf3 Bb4+ 7. Nc3
lines.sourceText: Well done! We're a bit better than black here

lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 c5 2. c3 Nc6 3. d4 cxd4 4. cxd4 e6 5. d5 exd5 6. exd5 Ne5 7. Nc3
lines.sourceText: Well done! We're slightly better than black here

lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 c5 2. c3 e5 3. Nf3 Nc6 4. Bc4
lines.sourceText: Well done! I like our position here

lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 c5 2. c3 e6 3. d4 cxd4 4. cxd4 d5 5. e5 Nc6 6. Nf3 Nge7 7. Nc3
lines.sourceText: OK, pretty even game from here, though I'll definitely take our position over Black's

lines.pgn: 1.e4 c5 2.c3 Nc6 3.d4 cxd4 4.cxd4 d5 5.exd5 Qxd5 6.Nf3 Bg4 7.Nc3 Bxf3 8.gxf3 Qxd4 9.Qxd4 Nxd4 10.Nb5 Nc2+ 11.Kd1 Nxa1 12.Nc7+ Kd7 13.Nxa8

lines.sourceText: Both sides played perfectly, but at least we have an interesting game ahead of us a free pawn in our pocket.

courses.name: Дебют на офицера (Bishop's Opening)
courses.plan: Използвайте диагонала към f7, развивайте конете и подгответе d4, когато центърът позволява.
courses.introduction: Играете с белите. След 1. e4 e5 развивате офицера с 2. Bc4. Натискът срещу f7 и възможните преходи към Виенска или Италианска партия определят плановете ви.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nf6 3.d4 Nxe4 4.dxe5 Bc5 5.Qd5 Bxf2+ 6.Kf1 O-O 7.Qxe4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nf6 3. d4 Nxe4 4. dxe5 Bc5 5. Qd5 Bxf2+ 6. Kf1 O-O 7. Qxe4
lines.sourceText: A pawn for a knight? That's a good trade

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nf6 3.d4 exd4 4.Nf3 Nxe4 5.Qxd4 Nd6 6.O-O Nxc4 7.Re1+ Be7 8.Qxg7 Rf8 9.Bh6
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nf6 3. d4 exd4 4. Nf3 Nxe4 5. Qxd4 Nd6 6. O-O Nxc4 7. Re1+ Be7 8. Qxg7 Rf8 9. Bh6
lines.sourceText: With black's bishop pinned to the king, black's rook is lost. There is no good way to save it. The best black can do is try and get their king to escape before checkmate but honestly, they have no chance at winning this game.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nf6 3.d4 exd4 4.Nf3 Bc5 5.e5 Ng4 6.h3 Nxf2 7.Kxf2 d3+ 8.Kf1 dxc2 9.Qxc2
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nf6 3. d4 exd4 4. Nf3 Bc5 5. e5 Ng4 6. h3 Nxf2 7. Kxf2 d3+ 8. Kf1 dxc2 9. Qxc2
lines.sourceText: Points to black for the cool (but meaningless) sacrifice

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 d6 3.Nf3 h6 4.d4 exd4 5.c3 dxc3 6.Bxf7+ Kxf7 7.Ne5+ Ke8 8.Qh5+ Ke7 9.Qf7#
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 d6 3. Nf3 h6 4. d4 exd4 5. c3 dxc3 6. Bxf7+ Kxf7 7. Ne5+ Ke8 8. Qh5+ Ke7 9. Qf7#
lines.sourceText: But hey! At least black didn't lose their queen right :D

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nf6 3.d4 Nxe4 4.dxe5 d5 5.Bxd5 Nc5 6.Bxf7+ Ke7 7.Bg5+ Kxf7 8.Bxd8
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nf6 3. d4 Nxe4 4. dxe5 d5 5. Bxd5 Nc5 6. Bxf7+ Ke7 7. Bg5+ Kxf7 8. Bxd8
lines.sourceText: Don't you just love free queens?

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nf6 3.d4 Nc6 4.d5 Nd4 5.c3 b5 6.Bd3 Bc5 7.cxd4 Bxd4 8.Nf3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nf6 3. d4 Nc6 4. d5 Nd4 5. c3 b5 6. Bd3 Bc5 7. cxd4 Bxd4 8. Nf3
lines.sourceText: Nice! After we castle on the next move, we'll be a clean piece up

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 d6 3.Nf3 h6 4.d4 exd4 5.c3 dxc3 6.Bxf7+ Kxf7 7.Ne5+ dxe5 8.Qxd8
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 d6 3. Nf3 h6 4. d4 exd4 5. c3 dxc3 6. Bxf7+ Kxf7 7. Ne5+ dxe5 8. Qxd8
lines.sourceText: That was insane

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nf6 3.d4 d6 4.dxe5 dxe5 5.Qxd8+ Kxd8 6.Nf3 Nc6 7.Ng5 Be6 8.Bxe6 fxe6 9.Nf7+ Ke7 10.Nxh8
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nf6 3. d4 d6 4. dxe5 dxe5 5. Qxd8+ Kxd8 6. Nf3 Nc6 7. Ng5 Be6 8. Bxe6 fxe6 9. Nf7+ Ke7 10. Nxh8
lines.sourceText: Our knight is trapped but who cares - we won a rook!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nc6 3.Nc3 Bc5 4.Qg4 Qf6 5.Nd5 Qxf2+ 6.Kd1 d6 7.Qxg7 Be6 8.Nxc7+ Kd7 9.Nxe6 Nge7 10.Nh3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nc6 3. Nc3 Bc5 4. Qg4 Qf6 5. Nd5 Qxf2+ 6. Kd1 d6 7. Qxg7 Be6 8. Nxc7+ Kd7 9. Nxe6 Nge7 10. Nh3
lines.sourceText: This line was one of my favorites from the Vienna Game course. There are a lot of variations, so if you want to dive deeper, definitely check out that course—after finishing this one, of course.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Bc5 3.d4 Bxd4 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.Nxd4 Nxd4 6.Be3 Nc6 7.Qg4 Qf6 8.Nc3 d5 9.Qg3 dxc4 10.Nd5 Qg6 11.Nxc7+ Kd8 12.Nxa8 Qxg3 13.O-O-O+ Bd7 14.fxg3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Bc5 3. d4 Bxd4 4. Nf3 Nc6 5. Nxd4 Nxd4 6. Be3 Nc6 7. Qg4 Qf6 8. Nc3 d5 9. Qg3 dxc4 10. Nd5 Qg6 11. Nxc7+ Kd8 12. Nxa8 Qxg3 13. O-O-O+ Bd7 14. fxg3
lines.sourceText: Well done! From here we'll win the game with our 2 point material advantage

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nf6 3.d4 Nxe4 4.dxe5 Nc6 5.Bxf7+ Kxf7 6.Qd5+ Ke8 7.Qxe4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nf6 3. d4 Nxe4 4. dxe5 Nc6 5. Bxf7+ Kxf7 6. Qd5+ Ke8 7. Qxe4
lines.sourceText: Who doesn't love being a pawn up?

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nf6 3.d4 exd4 4.Nf3 Nxe4 5.Qxd4 Nf6 6.Nc3 Nc6 7.Qh4 Be7 8.Bg5 O-O 9.O-O-O d6 10.Bd3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nf6 3. d4 exd4 4. Nf3 Nxe4 5. Qxd4 Nf6 6. Nc3 Nc6 7. Qh4 Be7 8. Bg5 O-O 9. O-O-O d6 10. Bd3
lines.sourceText: Black is almost paralyzed. Meanwhile all our pieces are super active and pointed towards his king. That's why from here, we win over 75% of the time!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nf6 3.d4 d5 4.dxe5 dxc4 5.Qxd8+ Kxd8 6.exf6 gxf6 7.Nc3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nf6 3. d4 d5 4. dxe5 dxc4 5. Qxd8+ Kxd8 6. exf6 gxf6 7. Nc3
lines.sourceText: Nice! Black can't castle and they have doubled isolated pawns on the f-file. The computer gives us almost a +1 point advantage for that.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.d3 Bc5 5.Bg5 d6 6.Nd5 h6 7.Bxf6 gxf6 8.Ne2
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nc6 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. d3 Bc5 5. Bg5 d6 6. Nd5 h6 7. Bxf6 gxf6 8. Ne2
lines.sourceText: Perfectly played! Black's kingside pawn structure is so messed up that we have +0.5 point advantage on the eval bar

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.d3 Bc5 5.Bg5 h6 6.Bh4 g5 7.Bg3 d6 8.h4 g4 9.h5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nc6 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. d3 Bc5 5. Bg5 h6 6. Bh4 g5 7. Bg3 d6 8. h4 g4 9. h5
lines.sourceText: Nice! Black's kingside is extremely weak and we have a +1 point eval advantage over our opponent.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.d3 Bb4 5.Ne2 O-O 6.O-O
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nc6 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. d3 Bb4 5. Ne2 O-O 6. O-O
lines.sourceText: Nice! Not the craziest line in the bishop's opening, but we made it out with a slight advantage over black.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.d3 Bc5 5.Bg5 O-O 6.Nd5 Be7 7.Nxe7+ Qxe7 8.Ne2
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nc6 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. d3 Bc5 5. Bg5 O-O 6. Nd5 Be7 7. Nxe7+ Qxe7 8. Ne2
lines.sourceText: Perfectly played! We have an advantage over black in this game.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Nf6 3.d4 exd4 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.e5 d5 6.Bb5 Ne4 7.Nxd4 Bd7 8.Bxc6 bxc6 9.O-O
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nf6 3. d4 exd4 4. Nf3 Nc6 5. e5 d5 6. Bb5 Ne4 7. Nxd4 Bd7 8. Bxc6 bxc6 9. O-O
lines.sourceText: A perfectly played game from both sides! From here you'll have to play a real game of chess

lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Bc5 3. d4 exd4 4. Bxf7+ Kxf7 5. Qh5+ g6 6. Qxc5 Nc6 7. Nf3 d6 8. Qd5+ Be6 9. Ng5+ Ke7 10. Qxe6+
lines.sourceText: Mate in 1 after this. You got it :)

courses.name: Виенска партия (Vienna Game)
courses.plan: Поддържайте центъра с e4 и Nc3, развивайте останалите фигури и избирайте между спокоен план и активен пробив според отговора на черните.
courses.introduction: Играете с белите. Виенската партия започва с 1. e4 e5 2. Nc3. Развивате дамския кон преди царския и запазвате възможността за активна игра с f4.

courses.name: Защита срещу Виенския гамбит (Vienna Gambit Counter)
courses.plan: Оспорвайте центъра с ...d5, следете реда на вземанията и развивайте фигурите, преди да събирате странични пешки.
courses.introduction: Играете с черните срещу Виенския гамбит. След 1. e4 e5 2. Nc3 Nf6 3. f4 централният отговор ...d5 е основна идея. Упражнявайте защитата и контраатаката срещу белия център.

lines.sourceText: Well done! It's a tense position, but we win over 60% of our games from here.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.f4 d5 4.exd5 Nxd5 5.Nxd5 Qxd5 6.fxe5 Nc6 7.Nf3 Bg4 8.Be2 Nxe5 9.Nxe5 Qxe5 10.d4 Qe7
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nc3 Nf6 3. f4 d5 4. exd5 Nxd5 5. Nxd5 Qxd5 6. fxe5 Nc6 7. Nf3 Bg4 8. Be2 Nxe5 9. Nxe5 Qxe5 10. d4 Qe7
lines.sourceText: Well done! I'm not kidding you when I say black has won 90% of games from here, just because white literally can't move any pieces. They are completely stuck. In the future we'll long castle and life is good.

courses.name: Дебют Понциани (Ponziani)
courses.plan: Използвайте c3, за да подготвите d4, и развивайте фигурите с темпо. Следете натиска на черните срещу e4.
courses.introduction: Играете с белите. Дебют Понциани започва с 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3. Подготвяте силен пешечен център, но ранният ход c3 изисква точна реакция на ...d5 и ...Nf6.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 Bc5 4.d4 exd4 5.cxd4 Bb4+ 6.Nc3 d6 7.d5 Ne5 8.Qa4+ Bd7 9.Qxb4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 Bc5 4. d4 exd4 5. cxd4 Bb4+ 6. Nc3 d6 7. d5 Ne5 8. Qa4+ Bd7 9. Qxb4
lines.sourceText: Well done! We are a full piece ahead and have a dominant position.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 d5 4.Qa4 dxe4 5.Nxe5 Bd7 6.Nxd7 Qxd7 7.Qxe4+ Be7 8.d4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 d5 4. Qa4 dxe4 5. Nxe5 Bd7 6. Nxd7 Qxd7 7. Qxe4+ Be7 8. d4
lines.sourceText: Well done! We are up a pawn and have much better position than our opponent. We'll move our queen to safety, develop our bishop, and castle kingside.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 Nf6 4.d4 Nxe4 5.d5 Ne7 6.Nxe5 d6 7.Bb5+ c6 8.dxc6 bxc6 9.Nxc6 Qb6 10.Nd4+
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 Nf6 4. d4 Nxe4 5. d5 Ne7 6. Nxe5 d6 7. Bb5+ c6 8. dxc6 bxc6 9. Nxc6 Qb6 10. Nd4+
lines.sourceText: Well done! Black will have to move their king out of the way, losing their ability to castle. We are a pawn up and our position is so good that the computer puts our position at a +4 point advantage.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 Nf6 4.d4 Nxe4 5.d5 Ne7 6.Nxe5 d6 7.Bb5+ c6 8.dxc6 bxc6 9.Nxc6 Nxc6 10.Bxc6+ Bd7 11.Bxe4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 Nf6 4. d4 Nxe4 5. d5 Ne7 6. Nxe5 d6 7. Bb5+ c6 8. dxc6 bxc6 9. Nxc6 Nxc6 10. Bxc6+ Bd7 11. Bxe4
lines.sourceText: Beautifully executed! We are way ahead in material.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 Bc5 4.d4 exd4 5.cxd4 Bb4+ 6.Nc3 Nf6 7.d5 Ne7 8.Bd3 d6 9.Qa4+ Bd7 10.Qxb4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 Bc5 4. d4 exd4 5. cxd4 Bb4+ 6. Nc3 Nf6 7. d5 Ne7 8. Bd3 d6 9. Qa4+ Bd7 10. Qxb4
lines.sourceText: Well done! We are a full piece ahead and have a dominant position. The computer puts our position at a +4 point advantage.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 Bc5 4.d4 exd4 5.cxd4 Bb6 6.Nc3 Nf6 7.e5 Ng4 8.h3 Nh6 9.d5 Nb4 10.Bg5 f6 11.exf6 gxf6 12.Bxh6
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 Bc5 4. d4 exd4 5. cxd4 Bb6 6. Nc3 Nf6 7. e5 Ng4 8. h3 Nh6 9. d5 Nb4 10. Bg5 f6 11. exf6 gxf6 12. Bxh6
lines.sourceText: Well done! We are up an entire piece and have humiliated Black's position. The computer puts this at a +5 point advantage for White.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 Nf6 4.d4 exd4 5.e5 Ng4 6.cxd4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 Nf6 4. d4 exd4 5. e5 Ng4 6. cxd4
lines.sourceText: Well done! We own the center and have a better position than our opponent.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 d6 4.d4 Bg4 5.Qb3 Bxf3 6.gxf3 exd4 7.Qxb7 Ne5 8.f4 Nf3+ 9.Ke2 Nh4 10.Qc6+ Ke7 11.f5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 d6 4. d4 Bg4 5. Qb3 Bxf3 6. gxf3 exd4 7. Qxb7 Ne5 8. f4 Nf3+ 9. Ke2 Nh4 10. Qc6+ Ke7 11. f5
lines.sourceText: Well done! Although we are tied in material, we are completely dominating the board and the computer puts our position at +2.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 d6 4.d4 Bg4 5.Qb3 Bxf3 6.gxf3 exd4 7.Qxb7 Nge7 8.Bb5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 d6 4. d4 Bg4 5. Qb3 Bxf3 6. gxf3 exd4 7. Qxb7 Nge7 8. Bb5
lines.sourceText: Well done! Black's position is crumbled and we will win this game.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 Bc5 4.d4 exd4 5.cxd4 Bb6 6.Nc3 Nf6 7.e5 Ng4 8.h3 Nh6 9.d5 Ne7 10.d6 cxd6 11.exd6 Nef5 12.Bg5 f6 13.Bxh6 Nxh6 14.Bc4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 Bc5 4. d4 exd4 5. cxd4 Bb6 6. Nc3 Nf6 7. e5 Ng4 8. h3 Nh6 9. d5 Ne7 10. d6 cxd6 11. exd6 Nef5 12. Bg5 f6 13. Bxh6 Nxh6 14. Bc4
lines.sourceText: Wow. Even though the material is equal, the computer puts our position at +5 point advantage. Look at how none of blacks pieces can move! They literally have no moves. The rest of the game is converting your dominant position into a win.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 d6 4.d4 exd4 5.cxd4 Bg4 6.Qa4 Bxf3 7.gxf3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 d6 4. d4 exd4 5. cxd4 Bg4 6. Qa4 Bxf3 7. gxf3
lines.sourceText: Well done! We have a winning position and are ready to continue developing.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 Bc5 4.d4 exd4 5.cxd4 Bb4+ 6.Nc3 d6 7.d5 Bxc3+ 8.bxc3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 Bc5 4. d4 exd4 5. cxd4 Bb4+ 6. Nc3 d6 7. d5 Bxc3+ 8. bxc3
lines.sourceText: Well done! We completly own the center. Even though material is equal, the computer puts our position at a +1 point advantage.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 Bc5 4.d4 exd4 5.cxd4 Bb6 6.Nc3 Nf6 7.e5 Ng4 8.h3 Nh6 9.d5 Ne7 10.d6 Nc6 11.Bg5 f6 12.exf6 gxf6 13.Bxh6
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 Bc5 4. d4 exd4 5. cxd4 Bb6 6. Nc3 Nf6 7. e5 Ng4 8. h3 Nh6 9. d5 Ne7 10. d6 Nc6 11. Bg5 f6 12. exf6 gxf6 13. Bxh6
lines.sourceText: Well done! We are up an entire piece and have humiliated Black's position. The computer puts this at a +6 point advantage for White.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 d5 4.Qa4 dxe4 5.Nxe5 Qd5 6.Nxc6
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 d5 4. Qa4 dxe4 5. Nxe5 Qd5 6. Nxc6
lines.sourceText: Well done! According to the computer, we have a +1 point advantage against our opponent. We'll be looking to develop our bishop and castle kingside in the future.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 Nf6 4.d4 exd4 5.e5 Qe7 6.cxd4 d6 7.Bb5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 Nf6 4. d4 exd4 5. e5 Qe7 6. cxd4 d6 7. Bb5
lines.sourceText: It's a tense position, but we are better and ready to castle at any point to move our king to safety.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 Nf6 4.d4 exd4 5.e5 Nd5 6.cxd4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 Nf6 4. d4 exd4 5. e5 Nd5 6. cxd4
lines.sourceText: Black has played the opening by the book, and we are in an equal position.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 d5 4.Qa4 Bd7 5.exd5 Nd4 6.Qd1 Nxf3+ 7.Qxf3 Nf6 8.Bc4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 d5 4. Qa4 Bd7 5. exd5 Nd4 6. Qd1 Nxf3+ 7. Qxf3 Nf6 8. Bc4
lines.sourceText: Well done! We are up a pawn and are ready to castle kingside.

courses.name: Царски гамбит (King's Gambit)
courses.plan: Използвайте бързото развитие и отворената линия f. Следете шаховете по диагонала към царя и не отлагайте обезопасяването му.
courses.introduction: Играете с белите. Царският гамбит започва с 1. e4 e5 2. f4. Предлагате пешка за активност и отворени линии, но едновременно отслабвате царския фланг.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 f6 5.Nxg5 fxg5 6.Qh5+ Ke7 7.Qxg5+ Ke8 8.Qh5+ Ke7 9.Qe5+ Kf7 10.Bc4+
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 f6 5. Nxg5 fxg5 6. Qh5+ Ke7 7. Qxg5+ Ke8 8. Qh5+ Ke7 9. Qe5+ Kf7 10. Bc4+
lines.sourceText: You probably have a forced checkmate here. At minimum you end up gobbling a few pieces and leaving their king stranded in the center of the board. Game is as good as over.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 d6 4.d4 Bg4 5.Bxf4 Bxf3 6.Qxf3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 d6 4. d4 Bg4 5. Bxf4 Bxf3 6. Qxf3
lines.sourceText: Beautiful! We are ahead in development and have the entire center.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 g4 5.Ne5 h5 6.Bc4 Nh6 7.d4 d6 8.Nd3 Bg7 9.Nxf4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 g4 5. Ne5 h5 6. Bc4 Nh6 7. d4 d6 8. Nd3 Bg7 9. Nxf4
lines.sourceText: We're doing great here! The material is equal but the computer loves our position.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 f6 5.Nxg5 fxg5 6.Qh5+ Ke7 7.Qxg5+ Nf6 8.e5 Bg7 9.Qxg7+
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 f6 5. Nxg5 fxg5 6. Qh5+ Ke7 7. Qxg5+ Nf6 8. e5 Bg7 9. Qxg7+
lines.sourceText: You definitely got it from here.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 f6 5.Nxg5 fxg5 6.Qh5+ Ke7 7.Qxg5+ Kf7 8.Qxd8
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 f6 5. Nxg5 fxg5 6. Qh5+ Ke7 7. Qxg5+ Kf7 8. Qxd8
lines.sourceText: Job well done.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 f6 5.Nxg5 fxg5 6.Qh5+ Ke7 7.Qxg5+ Nf6 8.e5 Rg8 9.exf6+ Kf7 10.Bc4+ d5 11.Bxd5+ Be6 12.Bxe6+ Kxe6 13.Qxg8+
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 f6 5. Nxg5 fxg5 6. Qh5+ Ke7 7. Qxg5+ Nf6 8. e5 Rg8 9. exf6+ Kf7 10. Bc4+ d5 11. Bxd5+ Be6 12. Bxe6+ Kxe6 13. Qxg8+
lines.sourceText: I just don't think it can get better than that.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 d5 4.exd5 Qxd5 5.Nc3 Qe6+ 6.Be2 Bd6 7.O-O Nf6 8.Bb5+ Bd7 9.Re1
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 d5 4. exd5 Qxd5 5. Nc3 Qe6+ 6. Be2 Bd6 7. O-O Nf6 8. Bb5+ Bd7 9. Re1
lines.sourceText: GG! This is a win for us.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 d5 4.exd5 Qxd5 5.Nc3 Qe6+ 6.Be2 Bc5 7.d4 Bd6 8.O-O Nf6 9.Bb5+ c6 10.Re1
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 d5 4. exd5 Qxd5 5. Nc3 Qe6+ 6. Be2 Bc5 7. d4 Bd6 8. O-O Nf6 9. Bb5+ c6 10. Re1
lines.sourceText: Black is not surviving this. Good job with this tricky trap!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 f6 5.Nxg5 fxg5 6.Qh5+ Ke7 7.Qxg5+ Nf6 8.e5 Kf7 9.Qxf4 Qe7 10.Be2 Bg7 11.O-O
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 f6 5. Nxg5 fxg5 6. Qh5+ Ke7 7. Qxg5+ Nf6 8. e5 Kf7 9. Qxf4 Qe7 10. Be2 Bg7 11. O-O
lines.sourceText: Black can do nothing. Multiple pieces will be lost. Multiple tears will be shed. Multiple ELO points will be gained by you.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 g4 5.Ne5 d6 6.Nxg4 Bxg4 7.Qxg4 Nf6 8.Qxf4 Nc6 9.Bb5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 g4 5. Ne5 d6 6. Nxg4 Bxg4 7. Qxg4 Nf6 8. Qxf4 Nc6 9. Bb5
lines.sourceText: Well done! Our pawn gambit turned into a pawn gain. The computer says we have a 1 or 2 point advantage here!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 g4 5.Ne5 h5 6.Bc4 Nh6 7.d4 d6 8.Nd3 Be7 9.Bxf4 Bxh4+ 10.g3 Bf6 11.c3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 g4 5. Ne5 h5 6. Bc4 Nh6 7. d4 d6 8. Nd3 Be7 9. Bxf4 Bxh4+ 10. g3 Bf6 11. c3
lines.sourceText: Well done navigating through all that! For the price of one pawn, we have the complete center, tons of development, and a safe king. Sure, some play is needed to win the game, but I like our odds.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 g4 5.Ne5 h5 6.Bc4 Nh6 7.d4 d6 8.Nd3 f3 9.gxf3 gxf3 10.Qxf3 Bg4 11.Qf2
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 g4 5. Ne5 h5 6. Bc4 Nh6 7. d4 d6 8. Nd3 f3 9. gxf3 gxf3 10. Qxf3 Bg4 11. Qf2
lines.sourceText: Everything is defended in our position & we have a strong attack coming. Good job!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 d6 4.d4 Nf6 5.Nc3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 d6 4. d4 Nf6 5. Nc3
lines.sourceText: We have a slightly favorable position and are ready to continue the game!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 g4 5.Ne5 h5 6.Bc4 Rh7 7.d4 d6 8.Nxf7 Rxf7 9.Bxf7+ Kxf7 10.Bxf4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 g4 5. Ne5 h5 6. Bc4 Rh7 7. d4 d6 8. Nxf7 Rxf7 9. Bxf7+ Kxf7 10. Bxf4
lines.sourceText: Well done. With a better position, we are ready to continue our game.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 g4 5.Ne5 Nf6 6.d4 Nxe4 7.Bxf4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 g4 5. Ne5 Nf6 6. d4 Nxe4 7. Bxf4
lines.sourceText: This is a great position for us, we are farther ahead in development and own the center. And what is Black's knight even doing?

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 g4 5.Ne5 h5 6.Bc4 Nh6 7.d4 d6 8.Nd3 f3 9.gxf3 Be7 10.Bf4 Bxh4+ 11.Kd2 Nc6 12.c3 Qf6 13.Kc2
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 g4 5. Ne5 h5 6. Bc4 Nh6 7. d4 d6 8. Nd3 f3 9. gxf3 Be7 10. Bf4 Bxh4+ 11. Kd2 Nc6 12. c3 Qf6 13. Kc2
lines.sourceText: Look - it's a weird position. Frankly, Black played all the right moves and you don't always get a dominant position at the end of an opening. That said, our pieces are strong, developed, and in the center. Everything is defending everything else. Our king is safe. Life could be worse.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 g4 5.Ne5 d6 6.Nxg4 h5 7.Nf2 Be7 8.d4 Bxh4 9.Bxf4 Bxf2+ 10.Kxf2
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 g4 5. Ne5 d6 6. Nxg4 h5 7. Nf2 Be7 8. d4 Bxh4 9. Bxf4 Bxf2+ 10. Kxf2
lines.sourceText: Well done! Our king loves running around in the King's Gambit, and that's totally fine! Go, little king, go.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 d5 4.exd5 Nf6 5.c4 c6 6.d4 cxd5 7.c5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 d5 4. exd5 Nf6 5. c4 c6 6. d4 cxd5 7. c5
lines.sourceText: The position is about equal and it's in your hands to win the game.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 g4 5.Ne5 d6 6.Nxg4 Be7 7.d4 Bxh4+ 8.Nf2 Bxf2+ 9.Kxf2
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 g4 5. Ne5 d6 6. Nxg4 Be7 7. d4 Bxh4+ 8. Nf2 Bxf2+ 9. Kxf2
lines.sourceText: Black played well; we played well. Black has a safe king; we have the whole center. It's going to be a good rest of the game.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 g4 5.Ne5 d6 6.Nxg4 Nf6 7.Nxf6+ Qxf6 8.Nc3
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 g4 5. Ne5 d6 6. Nxg4 Nf6 7. Nxf6+ Qxf6 8. Nc3
lines.sourceText: Another good playing from both sides. Good luck!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.h4 g4 5.Ne5 Nf6 6.d4 d6 7.Nd3 Nxe4 8.Bxf4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. h4 g4 5. Ne5 Nf6 6. d4 d6 7. Nd3 Nxe4 8. Bxf4
lines.sourceText: Look it's not a great end of the opening for us... We played a risky gambit at the start of the game and the opponent played all the right moves with 100% accuracy. Very very few games end up like this. Now it's time to earn your keep and play your heart out.
It's a funky position, but at the end of the day the burden is on Black to justify why they have two weak pawns on f4 and g4, and why they allowed us to take the center.

courses.name: Датски гамбит (Danish Gambit)
courses.plan: Използвайте активните офицери и бързото развитие, за да създадете заплахи срещу царя. Проверявайте компенсацията, преди да жертвате още материал.
courses.introduction: Играете с белите. Датският гамбит започва с 1. e4 e5 2. d4 exd4 3. c3. Предлагате пешки, за да отворите линии и да развиете офицерите с темпо.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.d4 exd4 3.c3 dxc3 4.Bc4 cxb2 5.Bxb2 Bb4+ 6.Nc3 Nf6 7.Qb3 O-O 8.Qxb4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. d4 exd4 3. c3 dxc3 4. Bc4 cxb2 5. Bxb2 Bb4+ 6. Nc3 Nf6 7. Qb3 O-O 8. Qxb4
lines.sourceText: Well that was easy.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.d4 exd4 3.c3 dxc3 4.Bc4 cxb2 5.Bxb2 Bb4+ 6.Nc3 Qe7 7.Ne2 Qxe4 8.Qb3 Bxc3+ 9.Bxc3 Qg6 10.O-O
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. d4 exd4 3. c3 dxc3 4. Bc4 cxb2 5. Bxb2 Bb4+ 6. Nc3 Qe7 7. Ne2 Qxe4 8. Qb3 Bxc3+ 9. Bxc3 Qg6 10. O-O
lines.sourceText: How does Black even play this position? It is impossible. The computer thinks that despite being a few pawns down, our position is so good we actually have a +3 point advantage. White wins over 80% of the time from here.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.d4 exd4 3.c3 dxc3 4.Bc4 cxb2 5.Bxb2 Nf6 6.e5 d5 7.exf6 dxc4 8.Qxd8+ Kxd8 9.fxg7 Bxg7 10.Bxg7 Rg8 11.Bf6+
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. d4 exd4 3. c3 dxc3 4. Bc4 cxb2 5. Bxb2 Nf6 6. e5 d5 7. exf6 dxc4 8. Qxd8+ Kxd8 9. fxg7 Bxg7 10. Bxg7 Rg8 11. Bf6+
lines.sourceText: Black's position is just destroyed. No two-ways around it. Good job.

lines.sourceText: Wow wow wow. We sacrificed 3 pawns and a knight and won all of it back and MORE. Good job.

lines.sourceText: Well done. We are winning the opponent's rook and also the game.

lines.sourceText: Well done! Black declined our gambit in this line. Our plan here is to just continue developing and castle king-side. You got this!

lines.sourceText: Well done! Black played perfectly against our opening and we managed to make it all the way to an endgame where we have a slight advantage. Good luck!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.d4 exd4 3.c3 dxc3 4.Bc4 cxb2 5.Bxb2 Nf6 6.e5 d5 7.exf6 dxc4 8.Qxd8+ Kxd8 9.fxg7 Bb4+ 10.Nc3 Rg8 11.O-O-O+ Bd7 12.Nd5

lines.sourceText: Well done! This is an absolutely beautiful position for us. We have a safe king, more development, and a pawn that is a huge asset 1 square from becoming a queen.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.d4 exd4 3.c3 dxc3 4.Bc4 cxb2 5.Bxb2 Bb4+ 6.Nc3 Nf6 7.Qb3 Bxc3+ 8.Qxc3 O-O 9.Nf3 Nc6 10.O-O d6 11.Rfe1
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. d4 exd4 3. c3 dxc3 4. Bc4 cxb2 5. Bxb2 Bb4+ 6. Nc3 Nf6 7. Qb3 Bxc3+ 8. Qxc3 O-O 9. Nf3 Nc6 10. O-O d6 11. Rfe1
lines.sourceText: Black played against us perfectly, but we aren't doing too bad. We have more development. We have a pawn in the center. We have a killer battery. This position looks really really good for us and White wins something like 60% of the time from here.

courses.name: Контрагамбит Албин (Albin Countergambit)
courses.plan: Използвайте напредналата пешка d4, развивайте фигурите и търсете тактика срещу белия цар и дамата.
courses.introduction: Играете с черните. Контрагамбит Албин започва с 1. d4 d5 2. c4 e5. След dxe5 черните често отговарят с ...d4, печелят пространство и създават конкретни тактически заплахи.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 e5 3.Nc3 exd4 4.Qxd4 Nc6 5.Qxd5 Be6 6.Qxd8+ Rxd8 7.e3 Nb4 8.Rb1 Nc2+ 9.Ke2 Bxc4+ 10.Kf3 Bxf1

lines.sourceText: Well done! We literally just have a free bishop. I don't need to tell you why that's winning.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 d4 4.e3 Bb4+ 5.Bd2 dxe3 6.Bxb4 exf2+ 7.Ke2 fxg1=N+ 8.Rxg1 Bg4+ 9.Kf2 Qxd1

lines.sourceText: One of my favorite lines on this website. I mean, we literally PROMOTED TO A KNIGHT TO WIN A QUEEN.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 d4 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.e3 Bb4+ 6.Bd2 dxe3 7.Bxb4 exf2+ 8.Ke2 Qxd1+ 9.Kxd1 Nxb4

lines.sourceText: Well done! We are a pawn up, we have a pawn 1 square from becoming a queen, we have stopped white from castling, and we have damaged white's pawn structure. Life is good.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 e5 3.cxd5 Qxd5 4.Nf3 e4 5.Nc3 Bb4 6.Ne5 Bxc3+ 7.bxc3 f6 8.Qa4+ b5

lines.sourceText: Well done! We're winning this knight no-matter what white does.

lines.sourceText: Yay!

lines.sourcePgn: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 e5 3. Nc3 exd4 4. Qxd4 Nc6 5. Qd1 d4
lines.sourceText: Well done! We now own the center and the computer gives us a HUGE edge over our opponent. We'll likely win from here.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 d4 4.e3 Bb4+ 5.Bd2 dxe3 6.Bxb4 exf2+ 7.Ke2 fxg1=N+ 8.Ke1 Qh4+ 9.g3 Qe4+ 10.Be2 Qxh1

lines.sourceText: Well done! We got our pawn back and are ready to continue playing chess! We win 60% of the time from here.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 d4 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.e3 Bb4+ 6.Bd2 dxe3 7.fxe3 Bxd2+ 8.Nbxd2 Qe7 9.Be2 Nxe5

lines.sourceText: Well done! We've equalized our material and have a better pawn structure. Odds are, we win this game.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 d4 4.e3 Bb4+ 5.Bd2 dxe3 6.fxe3 Qh4+ 7.g3 Qe4 8.Nf3 Qxe3+ 9.Be2 Bxd2+ 10.Nbxd2 Nc6

lines.sourceText: Well done! We are stopping White from castling and we have pressure on the e5 pawn. We win 60% of games from here!

lines.sourceText: Well done! Thanks to our very strong bishop and rook, we'll win most of the games from here.

lines.sourceText: Well done! 13 moves in, and there have still been thousands of games that have reached this exact position.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 d4 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.a3 Bg4 6.Nbd2 Qe7 7.h3 Bxf3 8.Nxf3 O-O-O

lines.sourceText: Honestly, white played that pretty perfectly. We have our work cut out for us to win this game.

lines.pgn: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 d4 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.g3 Be6 6.Bg2 Qd7 7.O-O O-O-O 8.Nbd2 h5

lines.sourceText: Well done! We'll march our pawn all the way to white's king. This opens up a file for our rook, and it'll be very uncomfortable for white.

courses.name: Контраатака Тракслер (Traxler Counterattack)
courses.plan: В острите варианти проверявайте първо шаховете, вземанията и заплахите към царя. Жертвите работят само при точна последователност.
courses.introduction: Играете с черните. След 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Nf6 4. Ng5 ходът ...Bc5 започва контраатака Тракслер. Това е остър дебют с жертви и конкретна игра срещу белия цар.

lines.sourceText: Sheesh.

lines.sourceText: Well done! We're down TEN points of material but our attack is so strong that Black wins 90% of the time here. I have never seen anything like it.

lines.sourceText: Well done! We'll win the knight on the next move. The knight can't really move because of our checkmate threat on f1.

lines.sourceText: After all these shenanigans, we're actually up material and have a safer king. Well done.

lines.sourceText: Well done! White's knight is stuck in the corner, most of the other pieces aren't developed, and the king is unsafe. the computer gives us a HUGE advantage here, and black almost always wins from this position.

lines.sourceText: Look at White's home row - half their pieces haven't even moved! We're down a bit of material but we have a suffocating position. Black wins from here 85% of the time.

lines.sourceText: We have a deadly pin on white's knight and - I hope you didn't forget - White's rook is still trapped in the corner, ready to be taken by our knight whenever we want.

lines.sourceText: Honestly this was just really good play by White. We're down material but the engine thinks we have some winning chances here. because white is so underdeveloped and all our pieces are surrounding the king. Good luck with the game!

courses.name: Гамбит Русо (Rousseau Gambit)
courses.plan: Използвайте натиска срещу e4 и възможностите по линията f. Развивайте фигурите и следете слабостите около собствения цар.
courses.introduction: Играете с черните. След 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 избирате острото ...f5. Гамбит Русо създава незабавни централни заплахи и изисква внимателно пресмятане.

lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 f5 4. Nc3 fxe4 5. Nxe4 d5

lines.sourceText: Well done! We're just crushing white here because of our strong central control. The computer gives us a +1.5 point advantage

lines.sourceText: Two pawns in the center? Check. More pieces developed? Check. Going to win this game? Check.

lines.sourceText: It might not look like it, but we are actually way ahead here. Either white moves their bishop and loses their knight, or they move their knight and lose their bishop.

lines.sourceText: Well done! We simply have the center and more development, and we'll probably find a way to win that f5 pawn soon. The computer has us at a +1.5 point advantage.

lines.sourceText: It's a forced checkmate in 4, but I guarantee you white resigns at this point

lines.sourceText: Our attack on white is unstoppable. White's king is completely trapped with no squares to go to, and we're about to play knight to f3, forking the king and queen. The computer gives us a +6 point advantage.

lines.sourceText: I’m ending the line here because White can try a few moves to delay the inevitable, but in the end White’s rook is completely trapped and our pawn will turn into a queen.

lines.sourceText: We're going to win whites queen, and then the game :)

lines.sourceText: It's times like these that make me remember why I love chess so much.

lines.sourceText: Our attack is just crushing here. Despite being down two points of material, the computer gives us a +5 point advantage!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 f5 4.exf5 e4 5.Qe2 Qe7 6.Ng1 Nf6 7.Nc3 Nd4 8.Qd1 d5 9.Nxd5 Nxd5 10.Bxd5 Bxf5 11.Ne2 Bg4 12.Bc4 Qc5 13.c3 Qxc4 14.cxd4 O-O-O

lines.sourceText: Look how depressing white's position is here. They can't move their bishop (it's blocked in), they can't castle (or they'll lose their knight), they can't move their queen (or they'll get checkmated), and they can't move their knight (they'll lose their queen).

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 f5 4.d4 exd4 5.exf5 d5 6.Bb5 Qe7+ 7.Qe2 Qxe2+

lines.sourceText: Now white's position will get completely messed up! If they try and recapture with their bishop, it's an ugly retreating move, and if they recapture with their king, they can no longer castle.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 f5 4.d3 Bc5 5.O-O Nf6 6.Nc3 f4 7.a3 d6 8.b4 Bb6 9.Nd5 Nxd5 10.Bxd5 Nd4 11.Nxd4 Bxd4 12.Rb1 Qg5

lines.sourceText: With our bishop staring at f2, our queen pinning g2, and our bishop on it's way to g4 or h3, white is in a LOT of trouble here.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 f5 4.exf5 e4 5.Ng1 d5 6.Qh5+ Ke7 7.Bb3 Nf6 8.Qh4 Bxf5

lines.sourceText: Nicely done. Besides our king not being able to castle, life is great.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 f5 4.d3 Bc5 5.Nc3 f4 6.O-O d6 7.a3 Bg4

lines.sourceText: Well done! On our next move we'll play knight to d4 and apply maximum pressure on that poor f3 knight.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 f5 4.exf5 e4 5.Nd4 Nf6 6.Nxc6 bxc6

courses.name: Гамбит Енглунд (Englund Gambit)
courses.plan: Развивайте фигурите с темпо и проверявайте конкретните заплахи срещу царя и дамата. Ако белите избегнат капана, завършете развитието и оценете материалния баланс.
courses.introduction: Играете с черните. Срещу 1. d4 предлагате пешка с ...e5. Гамбит Енглунд разчита на конкретни тактически идеи; изучавайте и спокойните отговори, при които белите избягват капаните.

lines.sourceText: Well done! We have a huge lead in development, we have recaptured our pawns, and we are ready to castle queenside.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.f4 exf4 4.e5 Ng8 5.Nf3 d6 6.d4 dxe5 7.Qe2 Be7 8.Qxe5 Nc6 9.Bb5 Bd7 10.Bxc6 Bxc6 11.d5 Bd7 12.Bxf4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nc3 Nf6 3. f4 exf4 4. e5 Ng8 5. Nf3 d6 6. d4 dxe5 7. Qe2 Be7 8. Qxe5 Nc6 9. Bb5 Bd7 10. Bxc6 Bxc6 11. d5 Bd7 12. Bxf4
lines.sourceText: Well done! Our queen is forking the c7 and g7 pawns. Black is in trouble here and the game is likely ours.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.f4 exf4 4.e5 Ng8 5.Nf3 d6 6.d4 dxe5 7.Qe2 Be7 8.Qxe5 Nf6 9.Bxf4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nc3 Nf6 3. f4 exf4 4. e5 Ng8 5. Nf3 d6 6. d4 dxe5 7. Qe2 Be7 8. Qxe5 Nf6 9. Bxf4
lines.sourceText: Well done! We have a nice position here because our pieces are developed and active, and Black's pieces are kind of just... not doing anything.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.f4 exf4 4.e5 Ng8 5.Nf3 g5 6.d4 g4 7.Bxf4 gxf3 8.Qxf3 d6 9.Bb5+ c6 10.O-O cxb5 11.Bg5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nc3 Nf6 3. f4 exf4 4. e5 Ng8 5. Nf3 g5 6. d4 g4 7. Bxf4 gxf3 8. Qxf3 d6 9. Bb5+ c6 10. O-O cxb5 11. Bg5
lines.sourceText: Well done! We lost 2 pieces but our development is just too much for black to handle. We'll bring our rook and knight to the party next and the game is ours.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.f4 Nc6 4.fxe5 Nxe5 5.d4 Ng6 6.e5 Ng8 7.Nf3
lines.sourceText: Браво! Имаме огромна преднина в развитието и осакатихме позицията на черните. Въпреки че материалът е равен, шахматните енджини смятат, че тази позиция е толкова добра за белите, че е еквивалентна на това да са с 1 или 2 пешки напред! Край на тази линия!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.f4 d6 4.Nf3 exf4 5.d4
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nc3 Nf6 3. f4 d6 4. Nf3 exf4 5. d4
lines.sourceText: Well done! We own the center and are about to win back our material!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.f4 d6 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.Bb5
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nc3 Nf6 3. f4 d6 4. Nf3 Nc6 5. Bb5
lines.sourceText: Well done! We are ready to castle and continue our game.

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.f4 d5 4.fxe5 Nxe4 5.Qf3 Nxc3 6.bxc3 Be7 7.d4 O-O 8.Bd3 Be6 9.Ne2
lines.sourcePgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nc3 Nf6 3. f4 d5 4. fxe5 Nxe4 5. Qf3 Nxc3 6. bxc3 Be7 7. d4 O-O 8. Bd3 Be6 9. Ne2
lines.sourceText: Well done! We have a lead in development, are ready to castle, and have prepared a strong attack on our opponent's king!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.d3 Bc5 6.Bg5 Nxe4 7.Bxd8 Bxf2+ 8.Ke2 Bg4#
lines.sourceText: Мат! Добра игра! Край на тази линия!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.e5 Ne4 6.d3 Bc5 7.dxe4 Bxf2+ 8.Ke2 Bg4+ 9.Kxf2 Qxd1
lines.sourceText: И сме вече с царица напред и играта ни е в кърпа вързана! Край на тази линия!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.Nc3 Bc5 6.Bc4 Ng4 7.O-O Qh4 8.h3 Nxf2 9.Qf3 Nxh3+ 10.Kh2 Nf2+ 11.Kg1 Qh1#
lines.sourceText: Беше толкова естествено за белите да изиграят всички ходове, които току-що видяхме. И въпреки това те понесоха последствията като загубиха играта. Край на тази линия!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.e5 Ne4 6.d4 Qh4 7.g3 Nxg3 8.fxg3 Qe4+ 9.Qe2 Qxh1
lines.sourceText: Браво! Водим с материал и вероятно ще спечелим играта! Край на тази линия!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.d3 Bc5 6.Bg5 Nxe4 7.dxe4 Bxf2+ 8.Ke2 Bg4+ 9.Kxf2 Qxd1
lines.sourceText: Готина, а? Край на тази линия!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.e5 Ne4 6.d3 Bc5 7.dxe4 Bxf2+ 8.Kxf2 Qxd1
lines.sourceText: Мисля, че от тук ще се справите да спечелите играта! Край на тази линия!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.e5 Ne4 6.d3 Bc5 7.Be3 Bxe3 8.fxe3 Qh4+ 9.g3 Nxg3 10.hxg3 Qxh1
lines.sourceText: Толкова е лесно белите да се спънат в тези трикове и да загубят играта. Според компютъра водим с цели 3 точки! Край на тази линия!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.e5 Ne4 6.d3 Bc5 7.Be3 Bxe3 8.fxe3 Qh4+ 9.Ke2 Qf2#
lines.sourceText: Това беше забавно! Край на тази линия!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.d3 Bc5 6.Nc3 Ng4 7.f3 Nf2 8.Qe2 Nxh1
lines.sourceText: Така се прави! Отново сме с преднина от 3 точки според компютъра. Край на тази линия!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.d3 Bc5 6.Be2 h5 7.O-O Ng4 8.h3 Qd6 9.Bxg4 hxg4 10.e5 Qg6 11.d4 gxh3 12.g3 h2+ 13.Kh1 Qe4+ 14.f3 Qxd4 15.Qxd4 Bxd4
lines.sourceText: Ако аз бях белият цар, бих бил много депресиран! Водим с 3 точки. Водим в развитието. Имаме свободни диагонали за офицерите. Имаме пешка на едно поле да стане царица. Какво повече да иска човек? Край на тази линия!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.d3 Bc5 6.Bg5 Nxe4 7.Be3 Bxe3 8.fxe3 Qh4+ 9.g3 Nxg3 10.hxg3 Qxh1
lines.sourceText: Станахте ли фен на Стафордския гамбит вече? Край на тази линия!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.f3 Nh5 6.Nc3 Qh4+ 7.g3 Nxg3 8.hxg3 Qxh1
lines.sourceText: Много лесно, нали? Край на тази линия!

lines.pgn: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.d3 Bc5 6.Nc3 Ng4 7.Qf3 Nxf2 8.Rg1 Nxd3+ 9.Bxd3 Bxg1
lines.sourceText: Бум! Край на тази линия!
